assessments.reasoning: The pinned FSF COPYING.EXCEPTION directly states the named base, section and notice condition. The full-document digest agrees with the claim revision.
The pinned SPDX text preserves the opening condition and lists both GPL-3.0-only and GPL-3.0-or-later as typical uses. This contextual agreement supplies no separate file notice.

challenge.method: Tested automatic distribution-wide coverage and both possible blanket variant readings, GPL-3.0-only and GPL-3.0-or-later, against the opening paragraph.
challenge.results: The paragraph requires a file-specific holder notice and names GPLv3. It makes no universal election between those two file-level variants. Section 2 also rules out a general presumption about third-party software.

limitations: GPL-3.0 records the edition named in the exception. Determining a particular file’s version choices requires that file’s notice. The named edition is supported independently of any external lookup of the registry’s opaque target ID.
reasoning: The opening operative paragraph expressly identifies an additional permission under section 7 of GPL version 3. Application requires a notice placed by the file’s copyright holder stating that GPLv3 and this exception govern the file.
